Canonical mode-2 branch creates numeric text with scale 0.04 and alignment 1 and reveals child 0x13. Other modes leave the text pointer null and hide that child. Child 0x14 independently receives the mode-equals-1 predicate.

Checked normalization with !!arg1, prior-frame restoration, preview reset and forwarding of the original byte. Constructor and toggle callers establish observed states 0 and 1; neither reveals the mode-2 number panel. Existing local names remain suitable.

Constructor consumes all four model resources, retains the model GObj, allocates sizeof(*user_data), initializes fields individually and attaches HSD_Free. Heading and initial category presentation match the proposal. No whole-allocation clearing or compiled size is asserted.
